title: Tree Guide Lines Emphasize On Hover
description: Tree indentation guide lines should turn emphasized when hovering over a tree item row.
summary: Window options (WindowMeasuresTree) now participates in the same tree hover-path as detail-panel trees: window-measure-tree-row added to row/branch selectors and CSS :has(:hover) emphasis; WindowMeasuresTree wires shared useTreeHoverPathRootHandlers (extracted from Tree). Vertical guide z-index from prior fix applies globally.
